name: The Wondrous Wisdomball does not offer the unobtainable Wailing Caverns quests Waking Naralex and When Dreams Turn to Nightmares (#5457)
contract: Quests 999 'When Dreams Turn to Nightmares' and 1500 'Waking Naralex' carry QuestSortID 718 (Wailing Caverns) but have no starter, no ender, no text and no objective in the world data or in the captured client quest cache. The ball lists every quest tagged with a dungeon area, so before #8548 it handed both out (#5457: players held them, their bots could not take them). CompletesWithoutPlayerAction now withholds any quest without a player objective, so the ball must offer neither, and a forced accept of either is refused. Leaders of the Fang (914, required item 9738, Horde) stays offered to this Blood Elf as a control.

steps.label: Obtain the companion, as a purchase would
Using the item teaches its summon
Summon the ball in Wailing Caverns
An ordinary Wailing Caverns quest with an objective is offered
When Dreams Turn to Nightmares is not offered
Try to take When Dreams Turn to Nightmares anyway
Try to take Waking Naralex anyway
It never enters the log either
